title: A new upper bound for Sidon sets in $\mathbb{F}_2^{4k+3}$
summary: A subset $S \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ is called a Sidon set if no four distinct points of $S$ have zero sum. It is shown that if $n \geq 7$ and $n \equiv 3 \mod 4$, then $|S|\leq 2^{\frac{n+1}{2}}-3$. As a consequence, for any even $t \geq 4$, there does not exist a binary linear $[2^t-3,2^t-2t-2,5]$-code, strengthening a nonexistence result of Brouwer and Tolhuizen from 1993. As a second consequence, we also show that for an even integer $n \geq 4$, every almost perfect nonlinear (APN) function $F \colon \mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2^n$ has nonlinearity at least $3$.
